blocks.text: The Samsung Chromebook Plus V2 XE521QAB-M02US is a 2-in-1 laptop that can be used as a tablet or laptop. The laptop runs on Chrome OS. It has a 360-degree flip design and a lightweight build. The laptop features a touchpad with multi-touch support, a Built-in pen, a wireless mouse, and a 13 MP webcam.

items: [12.2" FHD Touchscreen Display]The bright and vivid 12.2" touchscreen 1920x1080 60Hz FHD display lets you stream your favorite shows, browse online, and more in stunning detail; Wi-Fi 5, Bluetooth 4.0, Webcam, Wireless Mouse, Integrated Pen.

[Powerful Performance with Intel Celeron 3965Y ]The 3rd Gen Intel Celeron 3965Y 1.50GHz Processor (2MB Cache, 2-Cores, 2-Threads) provides fast and efficient performance for everyday tasks; Intel UHD 615 Graphics.
[High Speed and Multitasking]It comes with 4GB LPDDR3 RAM; 45W Power Supply, and a 1-Cell 39 WHr Battery, You can use this laptop all day without having to worry about recharging.
[Enormous Storage] 64GB eMMC SSD; 1 USB 3.0 (Type A), 2 USB 3.2 (Type-C), Micro SD Reader, No Optical Drive, Headphone/Microphone Combo Jack.
[Google Chrome OS] This laptop comes with a light titan color and is pre-installed with the Google Chrome operating system, which is known for its speed, simplicity, and security.
